summary: Regression smoke test after CORS middleware change. Verified cookie-based auth flows in the browser end-to-end for both member (victoria@fisherfamily.com) and admin (thetruth219@gmail.com). Login, session persistence across reload, authenticated navigation to /dashboard and /directory (Address Book), and logout all work correctly. Admin nav (Admin Console, Members, Disbursements) renders as expected; member nav does not. No CORS errors in console; only the expected pre-login 401 on GET /api/auth/me appears, which is by design.
test_credentials: Member victoria@fisherfamily.com/Fisher#2026 and Admin thetruth219@gmail.com/FisherAdmin#2026 both verified working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CORS middleware regression validated via browser. Login/session/logout intact using httponly cookie + withCredentials. The 4 console 401s observed are the expected pre-login /api/auth/me probes on each navigation to /login.
